title: Structure engineering media frame
description: A square-cornered frame that crops a given image or video like object-fit: cover, or shows a flat placeholder: a muted surface on paper, or dark stone for backdrops, with an optional dark veil for white type on top.
notes: size it from outside (aspect-[…] or absolute inset-0)
name: structureengineering-media

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; it is cropped to the frame like object-fit: cover. Empty: a placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: light: a muted surface (images on paper) · dark: the dark stone used under white type

props.name: veil
props.description: lay a dark veil over it, as the original does under white headings
